messages:
jen: Heads up — promo stuck, deploy-bot failing to upload canary artifact to GCS (getting 429s). Seen on 3 consecutive uploads. Promo is blocked.

deploy-bot: ERROR: upload failed: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests
  at storage.upload (uploader.go:214)
  retry_count=3

matt: Can you paste the last few lines of the deploy-bot log and request IDs?

jen: Pasting logs: request ids r-cc9a, r-cc9b, r-ccd0. Backoff was happening but parallel promos kept hitting the bucket.

alex: Confirmed — cloud storage returned 429 for the multipart init endpoint. We had a burst of parallel canaries writing the same bucket; looks like the bucket-level quota got hit.

aya: Options: (1) throttle deploy-bot concurrency for that bucket, (2) switch to manual sequential upload for this release, (3) pin to last_good_image and promote manually later. Thoughts?

sree: +1 to pin and manual promote. Risk of partial/duplicate artifacts during auto-promo is high while storage is throttling.

jen: Decision: pause auto-promotion for this release. Pin deployment to last good image sha `sha256:abcd1234` (last green). We'll manually promote once uploads clear. If we see inconsistent artifact state we roll back to the pinned image.

matt: I'll update release notes and delay the change window by 2h. Also adding a temporary deploy-bot override: `DEPLOYBOT_MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS=2` and `RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=2000`. That should serialise uploads and reduce quota pressure.

deploy-bot: Applying overrides: DEPLOYBOT_MAX_PARALLEL_UPLOADS=2; RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=2000. Next attempts will be serialized.

ci-runner: Re-triggered staging upload job with serial uploads (job id: build-7890). Monitoring now.

jen: matt / aya — please take manual promote if staging upload succeeds and health checks look good. Ping me before promote.

aya: Taking ownership for manual promote. Will monitor artifact presence, token-level latency, and storage error rates. Running rollback runbook if anything looks off.

matt: Release notes updated: "Promotion delayed due to storage throttling; manual promote scheduled at change window." Change window set to 16:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

jen: Thanks team. Leaving thread open until canary promoted or rolled back. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: INFO: upload success after retry (request id r-ccd0). Artifact available in staging bucket.

aya: Starting manual promote now. Will post results in 5–10m.

aya: Promote succeeded, canary healthy (+0 errors on smoke). Unblocking release and closing thread.
